edition.notes: Collated from multiple Devanagari printings (sanatan-dharm, BhajanSangam, India TV GP-style, stotra.in). v1 भजेऽहम्; v8 आपन्नमामीश शम्भो. Phalaśruti (verse 9) included as traditionally appended.

description.hi: नमामीशमीशान निर्वाणरूपम् — गोस्वामी तुलसीदास कृत शिव स्तुति।
description.en: Namamisham Ishana — Tulsidas's eight-verse hymn to Rudra.
